Boosters
Integrated Extinguishers
“

For the Helldivers who like to play with fire, we have the Integrated Extinguishers Booster which reduces the time to extinguish flames if you accidentally set your teammates ablaze.

— PlayStation Blog

Integrated Extinguishers is a Booster in Helldivers 2. When equipped, it reduces the amount of time to extinguish flames when any Helldiver squad member is lit on fire.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Procurement
  • 3 Tactical Information
  • 4 Change History
  • 5 References

Description

Reduces the time in which a Helldiver is automatically put out from being on fire. This makes it so that Helldivers are no longer required to dive or go prone to put out a fire on themselves.

Procurement

The Integrated Extinguishers Booster is unlocked on the ## page of the Ironclad Democracy Premium Warbond for Medals.

Tactical Information

  • Although it is possible to immediately extinguish a fire by diving, a Helldiver will remain on fire for ## seconds before the fire extinguishes itself. With this Booster equipped, it is reduced down to ## seconds.
  • While situational awareness can make fire a minor issue, equipping this Booster allows for reduced harm against open flames.
    • Depending on the enemy, equipped weaponry, and/or environment, the added protection can increase a Helldiver's life expectancy on the battlefield.
